code: import API from "./api"; // 🧑‍⚕️ Get all doctors export const getAllDoctors = () => { return API.get("/doctors"); }; // 🔍 Get doctor by ID export const getDoctorById = (id) => { return API.get(/doctors/${id}); }; // ➕ Add doctor (ADMIN) export const addDoctor = (data) => { return API.post("/doctors", data); }; // ✏️ Update doctor export const updateDoctor = (id, data) => { return API.put(/doctors/${id}, data); }; // ❌ Delete doctor export const deleteDoctor = (id) => { return API.delete(/doctors/${id}); };

sourcesContent: import API from "./api"; // 🧑‍⚕️ Get all doctors export const getAllDoctors = () => { return API.get("/doctors"); }; // 🔍 Get doctor by ID export const getDoctorById = (id) => { return API.get(/doctors/${id}); }; // ➕ Add doctor (ADMIN) export const addDoctor = (data) => { return API.post("/doctors", data); }; // ✏️ Update doctor export const updateDoctor = (id, data) => { return API.put(/doctors/${id}, data); }; // ❌ Delete doctor export const deleteDoctor = (id) => { return API.delete(/doctors/${id}); };
